role: The abstract container behind every GUI window: the slot list, slotClick's seven click modes including the drag modes, mergeItemStack, the per-container transferStackInSlot dispatch, the close-time cursor spill, and detectAndSendChanges to the client.

members.name: inventoryItemStacks
members.note: the client display list; the native container keeps only the slot list

members.name: transactionID
members.note: The number only pairs a refused click with the client's C0F: the server keeps the refused window's key and refuses the row's later clicks (setPlayerIsPresent false, survival.c's refused flag) until the confirm, and the client echoes the number it got, so the count itself carries no state; playfuzz's refused-click pins (pf-sneakinv-g3, pf-gridclose-g10) replay it.

members.name: field_94537_h
members.note: Java's HashSet<Slot> identity order is not reproducible; the port keeps a deduplicated array (container.h header explains why that is equivalent)

members.name: crafters
members.note: single player; the S2F queue lives on the server player

members.name: playerList
members.note: single player

members.name: addSlotToContainer
members.note: the slot layout is built inside container_init per kind

members.name: addCraftingToCrafters
members.note: The listener's initial sendContainerAndContentsToPlayer (the S30 and the cursor's S2F) and progress bars, sent by each window's open path in survival.c; one listener (the player) exists in single player.

members.name: removeCraftingFromCrafters
members.note: single player

members.name: getInventory
members.note: client display list

members.name: detectAndSendChanges
members.note: The slots' S2F sync (survival.c:detect_and_send_changes) and the furnace's three S31 progress bars (survival.c:gui_furnace_progress); rows compare the client's furnace fields (cp.fur) in te-furnace-s1 and te-charcoal-s1.

members.name: enchantItem
members.note: Only ContainerEnchantment and ContainerBeacon answer it: world.conf enchanting = off, beacon = off.

members.name: getSlotFromInventory
members.note: the slot struct carries inv plus index, so the identity lookup is the field read

members.name: transferStackInSlot
members.note: n/a: the base (null): every Container class overrides it (ContainerPlayer, ContainerChest, ContainerWorkbench, ContainerFurnace, ContainerDispenser, ContainerHopper, ContainerBrewingStand, ContainerEnchantment, ContainerRepair, ContainerMerchant, ContainerBeacon, ContainerHorseInventory, GuiContainerCreative's); container.c ports each override

members.name: slotClick
members.note: all seven modes including the drags; gated by out/java/containers probe rows in test_containers.c; the mode-0 click ends in onSlotChanged, which resets a merchant inventory (container.c:slot_changed, trade-full-s1); the pickup's putStack(null) test reads the stack object Java holds (a merchant result taken whole, or merged onto the cursor, resets nothing before useRecipe; container.c, pfc-mergeresult-f311)

members.name: onCraftMatrixChanged
members.note: the result comes from craft_find_matching with the null world the probe passes

members.name: putStackInSlot
members.note: The client's S2F into its window (survival.c's packet pump); the rows compare the client inventory and window every tick.

members.name: putStacksInSlots
members.note: The client's S30 into its window, as putStackInSlot.

members.name: updateProgressBar
members.note: n/a: the empty base: S31s come from ContainerFurnace (overrides it), ContainerBrewingStand (overrides it; brewing = off opens none) and ContainerEnchantment (enchanting = off)

members.name: getNextTransactionID
members.note: The client's click counter; only its echo in the C0F matters, as transactionID.

members.name: isPlayerNotUsingContainer
members.note: single player; the presence timeout has nothing to serve

members.name: canInteractWith
members.note: per kind in gui_can_interact; EntityPlayerMP.onUpdate closes the window on false

members.name: func_94529_b
members.note: the drag mode/state encodings are kept as plain ints (drag_state, drag_button)

members.name: func_94532_c
members.note: same encoding

members.name: func_94534_d
members.note: same encoding

members.name: func_94528_d
members.note: same encoding

members.note: the per-slot share; the deduplicated slot loop is in the click body

members.name: calcRedstoneFromInventory
members.note: Comparator output only: world.conf redstone = off.

notes: container.h documents the deliberate omissions another lane owns: the dropped entity's motion, SlotFurnace's XP orbs, the crafting achievements and stats, and SlotCrafting's dead container-item branch. lane/idxblocks: the S31 progress bars and the refused-click confirm were already ported (the record predated them); the enchanting, beacon and comparator members are switches. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
